title: Disgusting attitude towards the customers
body: The fitness app leaves an extremely negative impression due to the terrible UI/UX. The design is outdated, elements are arranged chaotically, navigation is confusing and illogical. Instead of motivation to exercise, it only causes irritation and frustration
